units.source_text: 源氏大将照旧常赴左大臣邸问候。

en.t: General Genji continued as before to visit the Minister of the Left's residence often and pay his respects.

units.source_text: 他对于旧日的众侍女，关怀比以前更加周到了。

en.t: Toward the many ladies-in-waiting from former days, he showed even more thoughtful care than before.

units.source_text: 对小公子夕雾，也无微不至地爱护。

en.t: He also cared for the young lord Yugiri with the most attentive affection.

units.source_text: 左大臣见他心地如此温柔敦厚，不胜喜慰，对他诚恳招待，也同当年一样。

en.t: Seeing that his heart was so gentle and sincere, the Minister of the Left was deeply pleased and comforted, and received him with the same earnest hospitality as in former years.
